summary: RotaryCell is a hardware project that lets an unmodified rotary telephone connect to LTE networks using an ESP32‑S3 microcontroller. It builds firmware that runs on the ESP32‑S3 and communicates with LTE modules, requiring users to flash the device themselves. Makers interested in retro‑tech communications or IoT prototypes will find it useful when they need a nostalgic phone interface on modern networks. The standout strength is its fully open‑source design and functional benchmarks, while the main caveat is the limited community size and lack of easy package integration.

github.description: A portable, battery-powered cellular conversion for classic rotary telephones—fully reversible, with no modification to the original phone.
